h8.claim_ko: ZERO published papers compute a validated scattering signature from a drone mesh in a Sionna-class engine.

prongs.test_ko: 지면 기록이 있는 프로시딩·저널에 실렸다. 본문에 지면 채택을 적은 arXiv 원고는 `일부` 로 세고 프리프린트로 남긴다
표적이 기체의 3-D 표면 메쉬다. 큐브·점산란체·블레이드 1장·추상 복소계수는 제외한다
산란전계를 미분가능 GPU 광선엔진 **안에서** 계산한다. FEKO·FDTD 로 낸 σ 를 경로에 곱하는 것은 주입이다
계산한 산란 **진폭**을 측정 또는 기준해와 맞댄다. 도플러 위치·회전주기·능선 모양 일치는 운동학이라 여기 못 든다

h8.p1_rule_ko: 지면 기록이 있는 프로시딩·저널에 실렸다. 본문에 지면 채택을 적은 arXiv 원고는 `일부` 로 세고 프리프린트로 남긴다

scorecard.label: CellSense
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8. The ledger flagged CellSense (CE01) as an H8 risk because it reaches detection rates with Sionna; the risk is real on the DETECTION prong but the target is not a drone and no scattering signature is computed.

raw.P2: NO - no drone at all (drone/UAV string count 0)
raw.P3: YES - Sionna RT scenes built in Blender

scorecard.label: Clutter-Aware
scorecard.paper: Clutter-Aware ISAC (Liu et al.), Proc. IEEE vol.114 no.1, Jan 2026
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8; together with md-rt it is one of only two published papers putting UAV geometry into Sionna

raw.P4: NO - no RCS value, no dBsm, no comparison to measurement or reference solver; the Sionna scene is an illustrative case study

scorecard.label: FWA cube
scorecard.paper: FWA cooperative sensing (Zhang, Guo, Li, Wen, Jin), arXiv:2605.07623, archive-filed under published_by_venue/IEEE_ICC_Workshops_2026
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8, and is the single most useful catalogue entry: a Sionna-based UAV DETECTION paper that reaches 0.63% missed detection with a CUBE for a target

raw.P1: likely YES (the archive files it under IEEE ICC Workshops 2026; the venue string was NOT verified inside the PDF - treat as UNVERIFIED until it is)
raw.P2: NO - 'The UAV is modeled as a metallic cube'

scorecard.label: Great-X
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8; a genuine near-miss on the mesh-in-a-GPU-ray-engine axis

raw.P2: YES - 'Realistic 3D UAV models in Great-X' (Fig.1a caption, p1)
raw.P3: NO - Unreal Engine single-engine ray tracer; Sionna RT is the COMPARISON baseline
raw.P4: NO - no RCS, no dBsm; the reported metric is positioning error in metres

scorecard.label: LAMBDA
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8; it is the cleanest example of the RCS-INJECTION route (our taxonomy route c)

raw.P3: NO - the drone RCS comes from CADFEKO; Sionna RT only supplies the propagation paths
raw.P4: NO - quality control checks 'CSI/radar plausibility', not amplitude against a reference

scorecard.label: md-rt
scorecard.paper: md-rt - 'Micro-Doppler Signature Simulation of Multirotor UAVs Using Ray Tracing'
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8; the closest published Sionna + drone-geometry paper

raw.P2: PARTIAL - a single two-blade PROPELLER, not an airframe
raw.P4: NO - validated against its own analytical formula, and only kinematically

scorecard.label: OpenISAC
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8; abstract sigma_RCS in the radar equation

raw.P3: NO - Sionna is only cited as a related tool, not used

scorecard.label: Rzewuski
scorecard.paper: Rzewuski, Kulpa, Pachwicewicz, Malanowski, Salski, 'Drone Detectability Feasibility Study using Passive Radars Operating in WIFI and DVB-T Band', NATO STO-MP-MSG-SET-183, paper 13 (PDF metadata author 'Stanislaw Rzewuski', subject 'MSG-SET-183')
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8; the engine prong is the whole gap

raw.P2: yes (Parrot AR.Drone 2.0 geometry in an FDTD grid)
raw.P4: partial - the asymmetry is 'confirmed by the measurements [3]' and RCS estimation/measurement detail is deferred to reference [4]; no in-paper amplitude overlay

scorecard.label: SagittaSBR
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: 'Sagitta' here is the SOFTWARE name, not a UAV. The DLR Sagitta demonstrator is a real UAV, which makes this an easy confusion to make.

raw.P1: PARTIAL - base version accepted at ICCS 2026
raw.P2: NO - the target is an AIRBUS A380 AIRLINER
raw.P3: NO - own C++/CUDA SBR code (SagittaSBR), not Sionna
raw.P4: YES - vs analytical Mie for a PEC sphere

scorecard.label: Temporal-GNN
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8; catalogue entry for the point-scatterer-RCS-into-Sionna route

scorecard.label: Ziganshin conf.
scorecard.paper: Ziganshin et al., conference version, 'Ray-Based Simulation of Multistatic Scattering from Target Objects in ISAC'
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8 (wrong target class), but proves the method is publishable in exactly this form

raw.P2: NO - car model 3.3 x 2.1 x 1.7 m
raw.P4: YES - vs FEKO MLFMM and PO solvers

scorecard.label: Ziganshin jour.
scorecard.paper: Ziganshin et al., journal version, arXiv:2604.05991
scorecard.verdict_en: does NOT refute H8; the closest paper in METHOD, and the strongest structural precedent for what we are doing

raw.P2: NO - Mitsubishi i-MiEV vehicle mesh, not a drone

h8.q1_counter_paper: Rzewuski, Kulpa, Pachwicewicz, Malanowski, Salski, 'Drone Detectability Feasibility Study using Passive Radars Operating in WIFI and DVB-T Band', NATO STO-MP-MSG-SET-183, paper 13 (PDF metadata author 'Stanislaw Rzewuski', subject 'MSG-SET-183')
h8.q1_why_ko: 'WiFi 패시브용 드론 바이스태틱 RCS 를 아무도 낸 적 없다' 로 바꿔 말하면 거짓이다. Rzewuski 등(NATO STO, 2021)이 FDTD 로 그 값을 냈고 실측 검출까지 닫았다. 우리 새로움은 **엔진과 파이프라인**에 있다.
h8.q2_why_ko: '게재' 가 이 주장을 떠받친다. 프리프린트를 넣으면 간격이 이음매로 좁아진다 — LAMBDA 는 UAV RCS 를 Sionna RT 경로와 한 파이프라인에 이미 태웠고, Ziganshin 저널판은 메쉬 산란을 Sionna 안에서 실측과 맞댔다.
h8.rzewuski_venue_note_ko: NATO STO 회의 프로시딩 수록본이다. 이 처분은 우리 신규성을 좁히는 쪽이라 보수적이다

R2.label_ko: full-wave 솔버로 그 기체를 푼다 (광선엔진 밖)
R2.bought_ko: 바이스태틱 절대 σ 와 그것을 먹는 커버리지 예산

R3.bought_ko: 엔진을 건드리지 않고 얻는 자세의존 진폭

R7.bought_ko: 기하와 일관된 서명, 멀티스태틱 확장 가능
